subject: How does RStudio know that an shiny app has been loaded?

messages.subject: How does RStudio know that an shiny app has been loaded?
parts:
Hi,

I thought RStudio displays the "Run app" button if a file named "app.R" is loaded. A colleague of mine renamed the app.R file to another name and still the "Run app" appears. Thus I suspect RStudio looks for "ShinyApp" in the code, right? If yes then will this work also on the shiny server?

Thanks in advance  Sigbert
